text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the "Morioka Roadshow 
Festival". Invited by Yukino Bijin, I 
headed to the venue and found Gold City 
and Curren Chan there as well.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, everyone, thanks for comin'~! 
Please have heaps of fun today!
choice_data_list: Do your best on the Sansa taiko drums!
Good luck with the Sansa taiko drums!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
We're rooting for you. Though honestly, 
isn't the venue way bigger than expected?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that's right... Seems like everyone 
got super fired up makin' preparations, 
treatin' it as my big grand stage...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Just relax, Yukino-chan. You practiced so 
much, everything's gonna be totally fi—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG! SKREEEEEEECH!)

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Ayy! The speakers...!?

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? Equipment malfunction? Yikes. —Ugh, 
should we go somewhere else?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Aahh! N-No way... This is gonna ruin 
everything!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Kh... After all the hard work Yukino-chan 
put in... it's all my fault... I'm so 
sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mister...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...N-No need to worry! Even without flashy 
stages or fancy speakers or anythin' at 
all, we'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: B-But...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sansa—and my beloved Morioka—is somethin' 
folks can enjoy from the bottom of their 
hearts, plain and simple!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: S-So... please leave this to me...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm so nervous... but! Here I 
go——!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dodon! Do-do-don! Ka-ka-ka!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sakkora~~! Choiwa yasse~~~!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
—Huh, drum sounds...? —It says "Morioka 
Roadshow Festival"! Looks fun!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hey, City-san. Karen just thought 
of a way to hype things up even mo~re♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What a coincidence. Me too.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! L-Look over there! Aren't those Gold 
City and Curren Chan!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sakkora~ choiwa~☆ Yasse~♪

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: So cuuute~! I wanna join in too...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you too. Just follow our lead, it 
doesn't have to be perfect.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(B-Both of them...! Even Trainer-san! 
A-Alright... I gotta give it even more 
everything I've got...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: E-E-Everyoneeee! Join in with us~~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Man oh man~~! Thanks to you folks, it was 
an absolute smash! Yukino-chan, truly, 
thank you so very much!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I didn't do much at all...! I was just 
bangin' away on the drum like crazy. It's 
only 'cause City-san and the others danced 
along with me...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? Nothing 
would've even started without your drums.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's because you gave it your all.

Yup, it's all thanks to you trying your 
hardest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you like that was just so adorable, 
everyone couldn't help but cheer you on~♪

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Because you didn't give up, 
everybody followed your lead.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, it's a real "dondo bare" 
happy endin'—. Today's number one hero is 
you, Yukino-chan.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Kh, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Ehehe! I should be the one 
sayin' thank... y-you...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—S-Sorry to keep ya waitin'! Sorry for 
bawlin' like that earlier! I'm totally 
fine now~~~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Heh... Well, shall we head home?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Still, today was pretty wild. You 
almost snatched away my attention "again".

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Again...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...It just means you're a way more amazing 
horse girl than you give yourself credit 
for.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: U-Umm...? City-san...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, you three~! If you don't hurry up, 
we're leaving you behind~♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Yes! Comin' right now~~~!
